svg.title: CloudOps Asset Manager – Serverless AWS CRUD Architecture
svg.desc: Serverless AWS CRUD architecture with users, CloudFront, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, IAM, GitHub and GitHub Actions.
svg.text: CloudOps Asset Manager – Serverless AWS CRUD Architecture
Implements a serverless asset management workflow with a static frontend, API Gateway, Lambda-based CRUD operations, DynamoDB persistence,
optional S3 asset storage, and CloudWatch monitoring.
